title: Vitryne format v1: avatars/<id>/avatar.json
description: A body to drape on: its mesh (a glTF binary part, metres, Y up, facing +Z, the wearer's left = +X) and the named regions that pieces are placed around.

mesh.description: Path of the glTF binary part (model/gltf-binary): one mesh, triangles, metres, feet at y = 0.

pose.description: The rest pose of the mesh: A, T, or another label.

regions.description: Body regions, keyed by a name from the region vocabulary (FORMAT.md): torso, head, head-over, upper-arm-left/right, arm-left/right, arm-straight-left/right, leg-left/right. Garments refer to these names, so a garment fits any avatar that has the regions it uses.

measurements.description: Body measurements, mm, keyed by name (chest, waist, hips, height, ...). Optional; informational in v1.

region.description: A frame to wrap pieces around. axis: a straight line through origin along axis (towards the top of the pieces). path: a centreline through points (first = origin), smooth (Catmull-Rom), continuing straight past the last point; straight along the first segment above the origin. zero: the direction of angle 0 around the axis (projected onto the plane normal to the axis).
